resetTasks.title: Reset tasks?
resetTasks.bodyWithProgress: {{done}} completed task(s) out of {{total}} will be lost. The proposal and design will be kept.
resetTasks.bodyNoProgress: Tasks for "{{name}}" will be cleared. The proposal and design will be kept.

deleteChange.title: Delete this change?
deleteChange.body: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

archiveChange.title: Archive this change?
archiveChange.body: "{{name}}" will be synced with the active specs and then archived. This cannot be undone.

agentSettings.title: Agent Configuration
agentSettings.description: These environment variables will be hot-injected when launching the CLI agent process.
agentSettings.googleCloudProjectDesc: Google Cloud Project ID required for authentication.
agentSettings.systemActive: Will be inherited from system environment

agentPool.title: Launch Agent Pool
agentPool.body: You are about to launch automatic processing of the cards in the Todo column. Tasks will be distributed and processed in parallel according to their dependencies.

fullAutonomy.label: Full Autonomy
fullAutonomy.description: Agents modify the main codebase and move cards directly to DONE.

hitlReview.label: Review-based Development (HITL)
hitlReview.description: Agents work on isolated branches. Completed cards wait for your validation in the TO REVIEW column before being merged into Git.
